title: Course 1 Vocabulary Check
summary: Match the key words from Course 1 to their meanings. This quick check helps you warm up your memory before the final knowledge test.

steps.title: Vocabulary Match
steps.markdownContent: Match each word to its meaning. You will see up to four words at a time. Drag a word to its meaning, or tap a word and then tap its match.

items.meaning: A part that notices something, like light or a button press.
Instructions that tell a computer what to do.
A tiny computer chip that follows a program.
Start the program again from the beginning.
The part of the chip that follows instructions.
A place where a computer keeps code or information.
Information going into the Arduino.
A signal or action coming out of the Arduino.
A signal read as one of a few choices, such as HIGH or LOW.
A measurement that can change across a range.
A connection point for a wire or part.
Fast on/off pulses that can control effects like LED brightness.
A complete path that lets electricity flow.
The circuit’s shared reference and return connection.
A question the code checks before choosing an action.
Code that chooses what to do for two different cases.
Send a program from a computer to the board.
Say what you think will happen before a test.
Carefully notice and record what happens.
Check clues to find and fix a problem.
Two things that should agree but do not.
The flow of electric charge.
An unintended path that can let too much current flow.
The circuit board that holds a microcontroller and connectors.
Look at how things are alike and different.
Sending information without a cable.
A way for devices to connect to a network without wires.
The electrical push measured in volts.
A part that changes a signal voltage to a safer level.
Look again at ideas you have already learned.
A task that lets you use what you know.

learningGoal: Recall the important words from Course 1.
